notes: Fixes found by running the panel in an emulator at the wall tablet's exact geometry. A full-height tile now only shares a column when what it carries fits in half a row - the AC was being stacked into a half-height slot and rendering with its setpoint stepper cut off by the tile floor, and a light stacked the same way lost its warmth row entirely. Narrow tiles stop ellipsing their names: they wrap to two lines where there's height for it, and step the name down a size where there isn't (a stacked Half tile), so "Dining T..." reads as "Dining Table Light". The big 64dp icon head is reserved for tiles wide enough to afford it - it was eating the width out of the name on one-unit tiles.
